alarm.enabled.description: Enable or disable the alarm system.
alarm.enabled.label: Alarm System

alarm.seatbox-trigger.description: Trigger the alarm when the seatbox is opened without authorization.
alarm.seatbox-trigger.label: Trigger on Unauthorized Seatbox Opening

alarm.trigger.motion.description: Use BMX055 motion events as an alarm trigger source.
alarm.trigger.motion.label: Trigger on Motion

alarm.trigger.handlebar.description: Trigger the alarm when the handlebar lock sensor or position changes.
alarm.trigger.handlebar.label: Trigger on Handlebar Movement

alarm.trigger.buttons.description: Trigger the alarm when a brake, horn, or seatbox button is pressed.
alarm.trigger.buttons.label: Trigger on Button Presses

alarm.hairtrigger.description: Sound a short alarm immediately after the first detected motion.
alarm.hairtrigger.label: Immediate First-Motion Alarm

alarm.hairtrigger-duration.description: Set how long the immediate first-motion alarm remains active.
alarm.hairtrigger-duration.label: Immediate Alarm Duration

alarm.l1-cooldown.description: Set how long alarm-service waits after the first motion event before starting the level 1 motion check.
alarm.l1-cooldown.label: Level 1 Trigger Delay

alarm.honk.description: Sound the horn when the alarm is triggered.
alarm.honk.label: Horn During Alarm

alarm.duration.description: Set how long a triggered alarm remains active.
alarm.duration.label: Alarm Duration

scooter.dual-battery.description: Use both installed main batteries when dual-battery hardware is available.
scooter.dual-battery.label: Dual-Battery Mode

scooter.max-voltage-delta.description: Set the maximum voltage difference allowed when activating both batteries. Set to zero to disable the voltage-difference limit.
scooter.max-voltage-delta.label: Maximum Battery Voltage Difference

scooter.battery-keep-active-on-seatbox-o.description: Keep the currently active main battery running when the seatbox opens instead of deactivating it.
scooter.battery-keep-active-on-seatbox-o.label: Keep Active Battery on Seatbox Open

scooter.battery-aux-low-keep-active-ente.description: Set the AUX battery voltage below which the keep-active-on-seatbox-open override engages automatically.
scooter.battery-aux-low-keep-active-ente.label: AUX-Low Keep-Active Enter Threshold

scooter.battery-aux-low-keep-active-exit.description: Set the AUX battery voltage at or above which the AUX-low keep-active override disengages. This must be greater than the enter threshold.
scooter.battery-aux-low-keep-active-exit.label: AUX-Low Keep-Active Exit Threshold

scooter.auto-standby-seconds.description: Set the inactivity time before a parked scooter enters standby and locks. Set to zero to disable automatic standby.
scooter.auto-standby-seconds.label: Automatic Standby Delay

scooter.lock-on-bluetooth-disconnect-sec.description: Set the delay before a parked scooter locks after the connected phone disconnects. Set to zero to disable this behavior.
scooter.lock-on-bluetooth-disconnect-sec.label: Bluetooth Disconnect Lock Delay

scooter.brake-hibernation.description: Allow hibernation to be initiated by holding both brake levers while parked.
scooter.brake-hibernation.label: Brake-Hold Hibernation

scooter.handlebar-unlocked.description: Release the handlebar-lock latch and suppress automatic relocking while the service-mode overlay is active. This setting is transient.
scooter.handlebar-unlocked.label: Force Handlebar Unlocked

scooter.enable-horn.description: Choose whether the manual horn is always available, available only in drive mode, or disabled.
scooter.enable-horn.label: Horn Availability

values.label: Always Available
values.description: Allow the manual horn in every vehicle state.

values.label: Disabled
values.description: Disable the manual horn.

values.label: Drive Mode Only
values.description: Allow the manual horn only while the scooter is in drive mode.

scooter.horn-when-seatbox-open.description: Allow the horn button to work while the scooter is unlocked and the seatbox is open. By default, it is disabled to prevent the open seat lid from pressing the button and sounding the horn.
scooter.horn-when-seatbox-open.label: Horn with Seatbox Open

scooter.open-seatbox-on-unlock.description: Open the seatbox automatically when the scooter is unlocked, by any path: app or cloud unlock request, keycard tap, or hop-on release. There is no close command, so the lid has to be pushed shut by hand, and an open seatbox makes a lock request wait in the waiting-seatbox state first. Intended for advanced users; set it with lsc, not from the dashboard menu.
scooter.open-seatbox-on-unlock.label: Open Seatbox on Unlock

scooter.dbc-blinker-led.description: Flash the DBC boot LED with the blinkers: green for individual blinkers and red for hazards.
scooter.dbc-blinker-led.label: DBC Blinker LED

scooter.usb0-policy.description: Control whether USB follows dashboard power or remains available for SSH and Update Mode. The always-on override is transient and lasts until reboot.
scooter.usb0-policy.label: USB Policy

values.label: Always Available
values.description: Keep USB available for SSH and Update Mode until reboot.

values.label: Follow Dashboard Power
values.description: Bring USB down while the dashboard is off in standby.

scooter.logserver.description: Set the systemd-journal-remote endpoint used to upload journal entries. An unset or empty value disables log uploads.
scooter.logserver.label: Log Server URL

pm.default-state.description: Set the default power state used while the system is idle.
pm.default-state.label: Idle Power State

values.label: Stay Awake (run)
values.description: Keep the system running while idle.

values.label: Automatic Suspend (suspend)
values.description: Enter suspend automatically after the pre-suspend delay.

pm.suspend-when-online.description: Only relevant without a main battery: a main battery in either slot always blocks suspend. "Online" means an active remote-access provider (Sunshine via radio-gaga, a Librescoot uplink server, or any other provider reporting connected). Default true lets a locked scooter suspend even while remotely accessible; set false to stay awake while remote access is connected, at the cost of draining the auxiliary battery within a few days.
pm.suspend-when-online.label: Suspend Without Main Battery While Remotely Accessible

pm.hibernation-timer.description: Set the hibernation timeout in seconds. Zero disables the timer; values from 1 through 299 are clamped to 300 seconds.
pm.hibernation-timer.label: Hibernation Timer

pm.last-ditch-hibernate-enabled.description: Hibernate automatically when reserve power is critically low. Disable only for controlled batteryless bench operation; explicit and scheduled power commands remain available.
pm.last-ditch-hibernate-enabled.label: Last-Ditch Hibernation

pm.scheduled-hibernate-enabled.description: Enable scheduled hibernation using the configured cron expression and duration.
pm.scheduled-hibernate-enabled.label: Scheduled Hibernation

pm.scheduled-hibernate-cron.description: Set the five-field cron expression that starts scheduled hibernation. An empty value disables the schedule. Consecutive occurrences must be at least 15 minutes apart to prevent an indistinguishable hibernate and wake loop.
pm.scheduled-hibernate-cron.label: Scheduled Hibernation Cron Expression

pm.scheduled-hibernate-duration.description: Set how long scheduled hibernation lasts. The wake time is calculated from the scheduled fire time.
pm.scheduled-hibernate-duration.label: Scheduled Hibernation Duration

pm.wake-timer-max-seconds.description: Set the safety limit for wake-timer requests sent to the nRF52. Longer requests are clamped to this value.
pm.wake-timer-max-seconds.label: Maximum Wake-Timer Duration

pm.wake-timer-ack-timeout.description: Set how long pm-service waits for the nRF52 to confirm that the wake timer is armed before aborting hibernation.
pm.wake-timer-ack-timeout.label: Wake-Timer Acknowledgment Timeout

cellular.apn.description: Set the APN used for LTE attachment and the data bearer. Leave empty to use the SIM operator defaults.
cellular.apn.label: Cellular APN

cellular.auth.description: Set the data-bearer authentication method to none, PAP, or CHAP.
cellular.auth.label: Cellular APN Authentication

cellular.username.description: Set the username used for PAP or CHAP authentication. Leave empty when authentication is not required.
cellular.username.label: Cellular APN Username

cellular.password.description: Set the password used for PAP or CHAP authentication. Leave empty when authentication is not required.
cellular.password.label: Cellular APN Password

cellular.sim-pin.description: Set the four- to eight-digit PIN used to unlock the SIM and enable its lock. Leave empty to keep the current SIM lock state.
cellular.sim-pin.label: SIM PIN

dashboard.app.description: Choose the application launched when the DBC boots.
dashboard.app.label: Dashboard Application

dashboard.mode.description: Choose which dashboard screen opens by default.
dashboard.mode.label: Default Screen

dashboard.language.description: Choose the language used by the dashboard interface.
dashboard.language.label: Dashboard Language

scooter.developer-mode.description: Enable development and diagnostic controls. The default is enabled when either installed component runs testing or nightly, and disabled when both run stable.
scooter.developer-mode.label: Developer Mode

scooter.aux-battery.charging-system-warn.description: Control the dashboard's AUX charging-system warning. Suppress withholds the notification, the charging-condition telltale and the status-bar AUX warning icon. The warning fires when the main pack is active, the AUX charger reports not-charging and AUX voltage is below the charger's charging ceiling.
scooter.aux-battery.charging-system-warn.label: AUX Charging-System Warning

scooter.cb-battery.charging-system-warni.description: Control the dashboard's connectivity-box charging-system warning. Suppress withholds the notification and the status-bar CB warning icon. The warning fires when the main pack is active, the CBB is present and below 50% charge, and its charger reports not-charging.
scooter.cb-battery.charging-system-warni.label: CB Charging-System Warning

dashboard.shortcut-menu.items.description: Ordered shortcut-menu items. Each entry is a fixed action id (view, theme, debug-overlay, motion-debug, route-overview, skip-stop, stop-navigation) or destination:<uuid>:<icon> for a saved-location shortcut. Array order is display order; entries unavailable at runtime are hidden.
dashboard.shortcut-menu.items.label: Shortcut Menu Items

dashboard.backlight-mode.description: Choose a fixed screen brightness or adjust it automatically using the ambient-light sensor.
dashboard.backlight-mode.label: Screen Brightness

dashboard.service-mode-active.description: Report whether the settings-service service-mode overlay is active. This value is system-managed, read-only, and transient.
dashboard.service-mode-active.label: Service Mode Active

dashboard.show-raw-speed.description: Display the uncorrected speed reported by the ECU.
dashboard.show-raw-speed.label: Raw ECU Speed

dashboard.speedometer.max-speed.description: Set the maximum speed shown by the speedometer arc. The arc size stays fixed while its range and tick labels change.
dashboard.speedometer.max-speed.label: Speedometer Scale

dashboard.speedometer.origin-color.description: Set the speedometer fill colour at 0 km/h. The fill transitions from this colour to the normal arc colour as speed approaches the normal-range speed. Use #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB.
dashboard.speedometer.origin-color.label: Speedometer Origin Color

dashboard.speedometer.normal-speed.description: Set the speed where the fill reaches the normal arc colour and starts transitioning toward the warning colour. This must be below the warning speed.
dashboard.speedometer.normal-speed.label: Speedometer Normal-Range Speed

dashboard.speedometer.base-color.description: Set the normal arc colour reached at the normal-range speed. The fill transitions from the origin colour below this point and toward the warning colour above it. Use #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB.
dashboard.speedometer.base-color.label: Speedometer Normal Arc Color

dashboard.speedometer.warn-speed.description: Set the speed where the fill reaches the warning colour and starts transitioning toward the overspeed colour. This must be above the normal-range speed and below the overspeed threshold.
dashboard.speedometer.warn-speed.label: Speedometer Warning Speed

dashboard.speedometer.warn-color.description: Set the fill colour reached at the warning speed. Above this point, the fill transitions toward the overspeed colour. Use #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB.
dashboard.speedometer.warn-color.label: Speedometer Warning Color

dashboard.speedometer.overspeed.description: Set the speed where the fill reaches the overspeed colour. Above this threshold, the fill pulses between the warning and overspeed colours.
dashboard.speedometer.overspeed.label: Speedometer Overspeed Threshold

dashboard.speedometer.overspeed-color.description: Set the fill colour reached at the overspeed threshold. Above the threshold, the fill pulses between the warning colour and this colour. Use #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB.
dashboard.speedometer.overspeed-color.label: Speedometer Overspeed Color

dashboard.power-display-mode.description: Choose whether the dashboard displays power in kilowatts or current in amps.
dashboard.power-display-mode.label: Power or Current Display

dashboard.battery-display-mode.description: Choose whether main-battery status is shown as a percentage, estimated range, or icons only.
dashboard.battery-display-mode.label: Main Battery Display

values.label: Percentage
values.description: Show the estimated remaining charge as a percentage.

values.label: Estimated Range
values.description: Show the estimated remaining riding range.

values.label: Icons Only
values.description: Show battery icons without a numeric value.

dashboard.blinker-style.description: Choose how the blinker indicators appear on the dashboard.
dashboard.blinker-style.label: Blinker Style

values.label: Blinker Icons
values.description: Show compact blinker icons.

values.label: Full-Screen Blinker Overlay
values.description: Show a large blinking overlay across the dashboard.

dashboard.milestone-celebrations.description: Celebrate odometer milestones and special numbers with confetti and a banner after parking.
dashboard.milestone-celebrations.label: Milestone Celebrations

dashboard.hop-on-combo.description: Store the learned hop-on and hop-off combination as pipe-delimited input tokens. An empty value means no combination is configured.
dashboard.hop-on-combo.label: Hop-On/Hop-Off Combination

dashboard.show-clock.description: Choose how the time and date appear in the status bar. Date modes show time only until the system date is plausible.
dashboard.show-clock.label: Status Bar Clock

values.label: Time Only
values.description: Show the current time.

values.label: Day + Time
values.description: Show the day of the month beside the current time.

values.label: Alternating Time / Date
values.description: Alternate between the current time and the day plus month.

values.label: Hidden
values.description: Hide both the time and date.

dashboard.show-temperature.description: Choose when the ambient temperature appears in the status bar.
dashboard.show-temperature.label: Outside Temperature

values.label: Always
values.description: Always show the ambient temperature.

values.label: Warn When Cold (<10 °C)
values.description: Show the ambient temperature only when it is below 10 °C.

values.label: Never
values.description: Hide the ambient temperature.

dashboard.show-road-name.description: Choose when the current road name appears on the speedometer and map screens.
dashboard.show-road-name.label: Current Road Name

values.label: Always
values.description: Show the current road name on the speedometer and map screens.

values.label: Map Only
values.description: Show the current road name only on the map screen.

values.label: When Navigating
values.description: Show the current road name only while a route is active.

values.label: Never
values.description: Hide the current road name.

dashboard.show-speed-limit.description: Choose when the posted speed limit appears on the speedometer and map screens.
dashboard.show-speed-limit.label: Posted Speed Limit

values.label: Always
values.description: Show the posted speed limit on the speedometer and map screens.

values.label: Map Only
values.description: Show the posted speed limit only on the map screen.

values.label: When Navigating
values.description: Show the posted speed limit only while a route is active.

values.label: Over the Limit
values.description: Show the posted speed limit only while the scooter is exceeding it.

values.label: Never
values.description: Hide the posted speed limit.

dashboard.show-gps.description: Choose when the GPS status indicator appears.
dashboard.show-gps.label: GPS Status

dashboard.show-bluetooth.description: Choose when the Bluetooth status indicator appears.
dashboard.show-bluetooth.label: Bluetooth Status

dashboard.show-internet.description: Choose when the internet connection indicator appears.
dashboard.show-internet.label: Internet Connection

dashboard.show-cloud.description: Choose when the cloud connection indicator appears.
dashboard.show-cloud.label: Cloud Connection

dashboard.show-cb-battery.description: Choose when the CBB charge indicator appears in the status bar. When Low shows it at or below 50% charge.
dashboard.show-cb-battery.label: CBB Battery

dashboard.show-aux-battery.description: Choose when the AUX battery charge indicator appears in the status bar. When Low shows it at or below 50% charge.
dashboard.show-aux-battery.label: 12 V (AUX) Battery

dashboard.maps-available.description: Report whether offline map tiles are installed. This value is system-managed and read-only.
dashboard.maps-available.label: Maps Available

dashboard.navigation-available.description: Report whether offline maps and the routing engine are available. This value is system-managed and read-only.
dashboard.navigation-available.label: Navigation Available

dashboard.map.type.description: Choose between online and offline maps.
dashboard.map.type.label: Map Source

dashboard.map.render-mode.description: Choose whether maps are rendered from vector or raster tiles.
dashboard.map.render-mode.label: Map Rendering Mode

dashboard.map.view-mode.description: Choose between a tilted 3D view and a flat 2D view.
dashboard.map.view-mode.label: Map View

values.label: 3D Perspective
values.description: Show a tilted map that follows the scooter heading.

values.label: 2D Top-Down
values.description: Show a flat map from directly above.

dashboard.map.north-oriented.description: In 2D view, keep north at the top instead of rotating the map with the scooter heading.
dashboard.map.north-oriented.label: Keep North at Top

dashboard.map.traffic-overlay.description: Show live traffic over the map. This requires online tiles.
dashboard.map.traffic-overlay.label: Traffic Overlay

dashboard.route-preference.description: Choose whether navigation prioritizes travel time or distance. Shortest routes ignore other preferences, including cobblestone avoidance.
dashboard.route-preference.label: Route Preference

values.label: Fastest
values.description: Prefer the route with the shortest estimated travel time.

values.label: Shortest
values.description: Prefer the shortest distance and ignore other routing preferences.

dashboard.avoid-cobblestone.description: Choose how strongly navigation avoids cobblestones and stone setts. Higher levels permit longer detours. This requires compatible routing tiles and does not apply to Shortest routes.
dashboard.avoid-cobblestone.label: Avoid Cobblestones

values.label: Off
values.description: Do not apply a cobblestone avoidance penalty.

values.label: Low
values.description: Allow a modest detour to avoid cobblestones and stone setts.

values.label: Medium
values.description: Allow a longer detour to avoid cobblestones and stone setts.

values.label: High
values.description: Allow the longest detour to avoid cobblestones and stone setts.

dashboard.maps.check-for-updates.description: Check for map updates automatically once a week while online.
dashboard.maps.check-for-updates.label: Check for Map Updates

dashboard.maps.auto-download.description: Download available map updates automatically. This may use mobile data.
dashboard.maps.auto-download.label: Download Map Updates

dashboard.saved-locations.0.label.description: Store the display name of an indexed saved location.
dashboard.saved-locations.0.label.label: Saved Location Name

dashboard.saved-locations.0.uuid.description: Store the stable UUID of an indexed saved location.
dashboard.saved-locations.0.uuid.label: Saved Location UUID

dashboard.saved-locations.0.latitude.description: Store the latitude of an indexed saved location in decimal degrees.
dashboard.saved-locations.0.latitude.label: Saved Location Latitude

dashboard.saved-locations.0.longitude.description: Store the longitude of an indexed saved location in decimal degrees.
dashboard.saved-locations.0.longitude.label: Saved Location Longitude

dashboard.saved-locations.0.created-at.description: Store the ISO 8601 creation timestamp of an indexed saved location.
dashboard.saved-locations.0.created-at.label: Saved Location Creation Time

dashboard.saved-locations.0.last-used-at.description: Store the ISO 8601 timestamp when an indexed saved location was last used.
dashboard.saved-locations.0.last-used-at.label: Saved Location Last-Used Time

dashboard.recent-destinations.0.label.description: Store the display name of an indexed recent destination.
dashboard.recent-destinations.0.label.label: Recent Destination Name

dashboard.recent-destinations.0.latitude.description: Store the latitude of an indexed recent destination in decimal degrees.
dashboard.recent-destinations.0.latitude.label: Recent Destination Latitude

dashboard.recent-destinations.0.longitud.description: Store the longitude of an indexed recent destination in decimal degrees.
dashboard.recent-destinations.0.longitud.label: Recent Destination Longitude

dashboard.recent-destinations.0.used-at.description: Store the ISO 8601 timestamp when an indexed recent destination was used.
dashboard.recent-destinations.0.used-at.label: Recent Destination Last-Used Time

dashboard.route-plan.0.latitude.description: Store the latitude of an indexed stop in the dashboard's active multi-hop route plan.
dashboard.route-plan.0.latitude.label: Route Plan Stop Latitude

dashboard.route-plan.0.longitude.description: Store the longitude of an indexed stop in the dashboard's active multi-hop route plan.
dashboard.route-plan.0.longitude.label: Route Plan Stop Longitude

dashboard.route-plan.0.label.description: Store the display name of an indexed stop in the dashboard's active multi-hop route plan.
dashboard.route-plan.0.label.label: Route Plan Stop Name

dashboard.route-plan.0.reached.description: Whether an indexed stop in the active route plan has already been reached.
dashboard.route-plan.0.reached.label: Route Plan Stop Reached

dashboard.route-plan.current-step.description: Index of the stop the dashboard is currently guiding to within the active route plan.
dashboard.route-plan.current-step.label: Route Plan Current Step

dashboard.route-plan.active.description: Whether the persisted route plan is an in-progress trip that may be resumed.
dashboard.route-plan.active.label: Route Plan Active

dashboard.route-plan.keep-current-stop.description: Keep guiding to the current stop instead of auto-advancing while riding.
dashboard.route-plan.keep-current-stop.label: Keep Current Route Stop

dashboard.route-plan.updated-at.description: Store the ISO 8601 timestamp of the last change to the active route plan.
dashboard.route-plan.updated-at.label: Route Plan Updated Time

engine-ecu.kers.description: Enable or disable the kinetic energy recovery system.
engine-ecu.kers.label: Regenerative Braking (KERS)

engine-ecu.kers-power-dual.description: Set the KERS regeneration current used while both batteries are active.
engine-ecu.kers-power-dual.label: Dual-Battery KERS Regeneration Current

updates.mdb.channel.description: Choose the release channel used for MDB updates. This override is transient; after reboot, the channel is inferred from the installed image.
updates.mdb.channel.label: MDB Update Channel

updates.mdb.method.description: Choose whether MDB updates use delta packages or full system images.
updates.mdb.method.label: MDB Update Package

values.label: Delta Package
values.description: Apply a smaller package containing changes from the installed MDB version.

values.label: Full System Image
values.description: Install a complete MDB system image.

updates.mdb.releases-url.description: Set the base URL of the MDB release index.
updates.mdb.releases-url.label: MDB Releases URL

updates.mdb.check-interval.description: Set how often the MDB checks for updates. Set to zero to disable automatic checks.
updates.mdb.check-interval.label: MDB Update Check Frequency

updates.mdb.last-check-time.description: Report the ISO 8601 timestamp of the last completed MDB update check. Failed or unconfigured attempts are recorded in the attempt fields instead.
updates.mdb.last-check-time.label: Last MDB Update Check

updates.mdb.last-attempt-time.description: Report the ISO 8601 timestamp of the last MDB update check attempt, whether or not it completed.
updates.mdb.last-attempt-time.label: Last MDB Update Check Attempt

updates.mdb.last-attempt-result.description: Report the outcome of the last MDB update check attempt (running, update-started, up-to-date, no-release, no-asset, backed-off, releases-unavailable, settings-unavailable or channel-not-configured).
updates.mdb.last-attempt-result.label: Last MDB Update Check Result

updates.mdb.dry-run.description: Allow update discovery, download, and preparation, but skip installation and reboot on the MDB.
updates.mdb.dry-run.label: MDB Update Dry Run

updates.mdb.orchestrate-dbc.description: Power on the DBC and request an update check automatically when a newer DBC release is available.
updates.mdb.orchestrate-dbc.label: Automatic DBC Update Checks

updates.dbc.channel.description: Choose the release channel used for DBC updates. This override is transient; after reboot, the channel is inferred from the installed image.
updates.dbc.channel.label: DBC Update Channel

updates.dbc.method.description: Choose whether DBC updates use delta packages or full system images.
updates.dbc.method.label: DBC Update Package

values.label: Delta Package
values.description: Apply a smaller package containing changes from the installed DBC version.

values.label: Full System Image
values.description: Install a complete DBC system image.

updates.dbc.releases-url.description: Set the base URL of the DBC release index.
updates.dbc.releases-url.label: DBC Releases URL

updates.dbc.check-interval.description: Set how often the DBC checks for updates. Set to zero to disable automatic checks.
updates.dbc.check-interval.label: DBC Update Check Frequency

updates.dbc.last-check-time.description: Report the ISO 8601 timestamp of the last completed DBC update check. Failed or unconfigured attempts are recorded in the attempt fields instead.
updates.dbc.last-check-time.label: Last DBC Update Check

updates.dbc.last-attempt-time.description: Report the ISO 8601 timestamp of the last DBC update check attempt, whether or not it completed.
updates.dbc.last-attempt-time.label: Last DBC Update Check Attempt

updates.dbc.last-attempt-result.description: Report the outcome of the last DBC update check attempt (running, update-started, up-to-date, no-release, no-asset, backed-off, releases-unavailable, settings-unavailable or channel-not-configured).
updates.dbc.last-attempt-result.label: Last DBC Update Check Result

updates.dbc.dry-run.description: Allow update discovery, download, and preparation, but skip installation and reboot on the DBC.
updates.dbc.dry-run.label: DBC Update Dry Run

trip.counter-reset.description: Choose when the trip counter resets.
trip.counter-reset.label: Reset Trip Counter

values.label: After Each Ride
values.description: Reset the trip counter after every completed ride.

values.label: Daily
values.description: Reset the trip counter once per day.

values.label: When Main Battery Is Swapped
values.description: Reset the trip counter when the main battery is swapped.

values.label: Only Manually
values.description: Keep the trip counter until it is reset manually.

trip.expunge.description: Choose how long completed trip history is kept.
trip.expunge.label: Trip History Retention
